queries.text: "canções psicológicas" rendered literally as "psychological songs" (the Gurdjieffian sense of repetitive inner complaints); alternative: "inner songs" / "the same old song."

"ao renunciar ao impressionismo": the author’s playful use of "impressionismo" (the urge to impress); rendered "renouncing the wish to impress" (as "power to impress" in Magnetism in Social Relations 13-0013). Alternative: "renouncing impressionism," the proposed glossary term, currently limited to Masculine Reflections on Woman and Love.
